row.statement: Whatever the reporting route (electronic, CD or paper), an ICSR file containing the reported particulars must be prepared. PMDA accepts all three routes, but electronic reporting (EDI via AS1/AS2 or upload to the receipt site) is preferred; CD and paper reports may be submitted at the counter or by post.
